settings.memoryMeasurement: Per-child wait4 peak resident set in bytes on Unix; null on platforms without wait4 or for aborted processes.

protocol.description: Separate domain probes for billing and notifications, frozen before retrieval. New evaluation repositories, sparse agent-reviewed source labels. Does not change the primary 80-task corpus.

interpretation: Agent-reviewed patch-derived labels are sparse, not independently validated ground truth. Unclassified files are not noise. Failed cases contribute zero to recall and completeness. Supporting-range and judged-precision means show only available annotations; inspect annotation counts and errors. Public evaluation cases cease to be held out when used to tune ranking.
measurementNotes: Measured after the frozen implementation; primary, supplementary and validation batches overlapped on the local host. Primary/domain final runs use Context at 16000 tokens; the corrected 18-case replay uses both methods at 16000 tokens. The original baseline and first candidate retain all three budgets. Per-case wall time is diagnostic, not a controlled speed comparison. The separate Spring cold-index profile uses one benchmark process.
Source-policy changes can expand the indexed source set while pinned archives and annotations remain identical. Literal-baseline runs also use the new shared index and excerpt planner.
